# Chengyuan Zhang

> Postdoctoral Researcher in Civil Engineering at McGill University, working with
> Prof. Lijun Sun. Research on stochastic models of human driving behavior,
> Bayesian inference and calibration, and uncertainty-aware traffic simulation,
> from individual decisions to network-scale dynamics. ORCID
> {{ site.author.orcid | remove: "https://orcid.org/" }}. Contact:
> {{ site.author.email }}.

The research guides below are the best entry points: each one states a question
and answers it directly, then links to the papers, code, and notes behind the
answer. Dates and venues on the publications page are authoritative; the
research summaries are written for readers, not as a substitute for the papers.

## Main pages

- [Home]({{ '/' | absolute_url }}): {{ site.description }}
- [Publications]({{ '/publications/' | absolute_url }}): complete list of journal articles, conference papers, books, and patents, with DOIs, research summaries, code, and BibTeX.
- [Code & Data]({{ '/code/' | absolute_url }}): public implementations behind the papers, plus an in-browser ring-road traffic simulator.
- [Curriculum Vitae]({{ '/cv/' | absolute_url }}): education, positions, fellowships, awards, and academic service.
- [Talks]({{ '/talks/' | absolute_url }}): invited lectures and conference presentations.
- [News]({{ '/news/' | absolute_url }}): recent talks, publications, and research updates.
- [Teaching]({{ '/teaching/' | absolute_url }}): teaching assistant experience at McGill University.
